security.title: Security & Access
security.subtitle: Who can reach this workspace, and what has been happening in it.
security.honest_prefix: Your language lives in an access-controlled workspace. But remember:
security.honest_strong: a constructed language is not encryption
security.honest_suffix: : anyone who learns it can read it. Never use it to protect credentials or personal data.
security.how_1: Workspace data lives in the SELISE Blocks Data Gateway; every call uses your own signed-in identity.
security.how_2: Membership is re-checked on every workspace action in the app's data layer, so data stays inside the team.
security.how_3: Sign-in runs through your organisation's SELISE Blocks SSO; Lexora never stores passwords.
security.how_4: Exports, imports and generations are recorded in the Activity Log.
security.how_5: Avatar files are stored privately; the browser only ever receives short-lived access links.
security.how_6: Signing out ends your Blocks session.
members.email_hint: They need a Lexora account first. Roles: viewer reads, editor writes, admin manages members.
members.remove_body: They will immediately lose access to this workspace. Their practice progress is kept in case they rejoin.
role_note.owner: Full control, can delete the workspace
activity.title: Activity Log
activity.subtitle: An honest record of everything that happened in this workspace.
activity.empty_body: Generations, imports, exports, renames, membership changes and deletions will all be recorded here as they happen.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace "{name}" · you are the {role}.
settings.rename_note: Only an admin or the owner can rename the workspace.
settings.appearance_body: Light or dark, everywhere in the app; same switch as the one in the top bar.
settings.backup_body: One JSON file with everything: the language and every version, the whole dictionary, phrasebook, generation jobs and the activity log. Lexora has no automatic server-side backup — this download is the only backup there is — so save one regularly.
settings.backup_toast: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe.
settings.backup_viewer_note: Only an admin or the owner can download the backup.
danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting the workspace permanently removes its dictionary, language, versions and history. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirm_body: Everything in this workspace (dictionary, generated language, all versions, practice data and activity history) will be permanently deleted.
danger.deleted_toast: Workspace and all its data were deleted.
danger.viewer_note: Only the workspace owner can delete it.
